summary: Improve waste audits, service controls and performance reporting in this five-day solid waste management course. Explore the outline.
lede: Solid waste management controls discarded materials from generation through recovery and final disposal. For waste operations supervisors, environmental officers and contract managers, the course develops practical skills in auditing and reconciling quantities, applying the waste hierarchy to operating choices, and monitoring service performance through indicators and contract evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who coordinate solid waste flows, verify service delivery or report environmental performance. It suits intermediate practitioners with routine exposure to waste operations who need a more consistent way to assess quantities, service controls and results.
modules: Solid Waste Operations and ISO 14001 Controls
Waste Service KPIs and Record Quality
Solid Waste Contracts and Cost Controls
Solid Waste KPIs and Action Planning
prerequisites: Working familiarity with routine solid waste handling, collection, environmental operations or waste reporting is expected. No coding or programming is required.
